title: The Studious Boy and the Secret Account Girl

terminology.ガリ勉: studious boy (but keep Gariben as the alias the students give the boy)

honorific_rules: Preserve Japanese honorifics such as -san and -kun when they signal relationship or social distance.
Preserve family vocatives such as Nii-san unless English dialogue requires an explicit natural equivalent.
Preserve school terms like sensei, senpai and kouhai, unless the English dialogue requires an explicit natural equivalent.
naming_conventions: Keep Japanese names in surname-first order: Kariya Tsutomu and Tachibana Matsurika.
Keep the anonymous account name as RIKA in all capitals.
Do not treat RIKA as an established alias for Tachibana Matsurika until the text confirms it.
style_instructions: Use natural contemporary English for a Japanese high-school romantic comedy.
Keep narration in close third person around Kariya Tsutomu and preserve his dry, judgmental inner voice.
Preserve clearly marked internal monologue and social-media posts as distinct text when present in the source.
When it's clear that a sentence is an internal thought, style it in italic.
Translate sexual material accurately and neutrally; do not intensify, sanitize, or add detail.
Preserve Japanese school and cultural terms that have an established English usage, including Golden Week and school festival.
